test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 19 Jul 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, "ENVOY" is written as "DMUNX" and "CHECK" is written as "BGDBJ". How will "ANGLE" be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d7fd46426f00ba56b91d423458faa673503496b14e50413ec14eae6a6e84c211.png] 

The logic followed here is :-

"ENVOY" is written as "DMUNX".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f0f922aabf5e6aff2cc1fed248e5181eb16d501649d17abcb6bfff63883468cf.png] 

and

"CHECK" is written as "BGDBJ".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/74ac40973875d5127a6f08cc0edcdc93569ee3a918d4ad33b637660891410c12.png] 

Similarly,

"ANGLE" will be written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/291d807e7e72be3d75708e6de26a05a58fbce23f0388f9f08e198cfd171f817d.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"ZMFKD".**
